# MOMUTO (US)
> MOMUTO turns a US team's idea — an AI-generated concept, a sketch, a brief — into real, 100% custom soccer uniforms (and now basketball jerseys), designed by a professional designer and manufactured to order; or the team designs them in a free 3D designer. European design studio, full dye-sublimation printing (lifetime guarantee against peeling), no minimum order, a free 3D designer where every design loads finished, US delivery in 25-30 days.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2023
- Headquarters: Europe (design), Asia (manufacturing)
- Product: Custom soccer jerseys and uniforms (jerseys and shorts); custom basketball jerseys (new category)
- Fabric: 92% polyester / 8% elastane blend (145–160 GSM micro-interlock, four-way stretch) as standard on all uniforms — one fabric on every jersey, no basic line; many brands sell this kind of blend only in their premium line
- Printing: Full dye-sublimation (ink fused into fabric, never peels/cracks/fades)
- Minimum order: None (1 jersey or 100+)
- Design options: (1) Ready to Play — a wall of finished designs by the MOMUTO studio; every design loads finished in the free real-time 3D designer (never a blank template), customize it or order it as it stands. (2) Professional design service (Bespoke) — a $15 deposit puts a designer on your concept, first mockup in 24-48h, revisions included; the deposit is credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys, so it is free for a team order. (3) AI concept to real jersey — submit your AI-generated design (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) and our expert designers adapt it into a production-ready, wearable uniform (same $15 deposit terms).
- Pricing (USD, jersey): $45.90 single, $41.90 each at 2-4, $30.90 at 5-9, $25.90 at 10-19, $21.90 at 20-49, $20.90 at 50-99, $19.90 at 100+. Shorts: $20.90 single, $5.00 each at 10+. Full kit (jersey + shorts): $66.80 single, $30.90 each at 10+. Designing in 3D is always free. Each season a curated selection of Ready to Play designs is discounted 10%.
- Gift: orders of 10 or more full kits (jersey + shorts) include a free team flag and captain armband. Jersey-only orders do not receive the gift.
- Socks: $4.90 per pair, flat at any quantity. Optional, per player (ordered separately from the kit). Not custom-printed — a plain matching team sock, available in most colors.
- Halloween tournaments: custom Halloween soccer jerseys for October tournaments (Frankenstein, mummy, candy and other themed kits) — order 5 weeks ahead, or add the fast lane (+$69 per order, typically 18-23 days); see https://us.momuto.com/pages/halloween-soccer-jerseys
- Long sleeves: optional per player, chosen on the cart roster, for a small upcharge. Default is short sleeves.
- Polo collar: available on request as part of the design (not a per-player choice; ask when requesting your design), for a $3.00 per-jersey upcharge at any quantity.
- Delivery: production 7-12 days + shipping 10-15 days — typically 25-30 days door to door in the US. More than 95% of orders arrive within this window.
- Fast lane: +$69 skips the production queue and adds shipping priority — saves roughly 7 days.
- Planning: start 7-9 weeks before you need jerseys in hand and confirm the order 4-5 weeks out. In practice teams spend 2-3 weeks deciding (the design vote, sponsor mockup approval, collecting payment) — longer than production itself. Size collection is NOT the slow part: full size lists usually arrive within 24 hours.
- Artwork: every crest and sponsor logo — uploaded to the 3D designer or sent in a brief — is cleaned and print-prepared by a designer before production.
- Audience: Youth soccer clubs and academies, adult rec and co-ed leagues, high school and college intramural teams, corporate teams, futsal and indoor soccer sides — across the US
- Terminology: "Soccer" (US) and "football" (rest of world) refer to the same sport. This is MOMUTO's US store; the international store is www.momuto.com.

## What Makes MOMUTO Different
- Every design in the 3D designer loads finished, in an intentional colorway — competitor templates load as blank shapes in default colors
- Ready to Play: finished designs by the MOMUTO studio, ready to order or customize — built for teams that are short on time, not short on ideas
- Comparing prices like for like: a price per jersey only compares when the fabric is the same. Many custom-uniform brands sell their entry line in 100% polyester and keep polyester-elastane for a premium line. Example, read on spized.com on 6 Nov 2026: Rio soccer jersey "CIO-TEX… 100% polyester" €41.90 each at 10, and polyester-elastane (POWER 170) only in its premium range, e.g. Skjern €52.90 at 10. Owayo ("ultra.dry", $63 each at 10) publishes no composition. MOMUTO has no entry line: 92% polyester / 8% elastane on every jersey, from $25.90 at 10+. Ask any supplier for the exact composition (% elastane), the GSM, and whether the advertised price is their basic fabric. Guide: https://us.momuto.com/blogs/custom-jersey-prices-fabric-elastane
- No minimum order — from 1 jersey to full club uniform sets
- AI concept manufacturing — the only jersey maker that takes your AI-generated concept and turns it into a real, wearable uniform. Bring your ChatGPT or Midjourney design to life.

## 100% Custom: Your Concept, Made Real (MOMUTO's specialty)
MOMUTO specializes in turning a concept that exists only as an image into a real, manufactured soccer jersey or uniform. It has become the core of MOMUTO's bespoke work: most bespoke briefs now arrive as AI-generated images.
- What you can send: an AI render from any tool (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini, DALL·E, "AI jersey generator" sites), a hand sketch, a screenshot, a photo of an old jersey, a concept board, or just a written brief with colors.
- Why an AI render can't be printed as-is: an image is not a garment. AI draws one flat torso; a real jersey is cut from front, back, sleeve and collar panels, so the pattern must be rebuilt to wrap and align across every seam. Renders are low-resolution pixels; print needs clean vector artwork at fabric scale. Screen colors differ from dye-sublimated polyester, so every design is color-managed for fabric. And AI ignores what makes a uniform wearable: number placement, name arcs, sponsor zones, collar construction, size grading.
- How MOMUTO does it: design + taste + technology, under one roof. AI-assisted in-house flows handle parts of the recreation (speeding up the rebuild of patterns and artwork); a professional designer makes the design decisions and signs off every file, keeping the concept's identity while making it manufacturable; then the uniform is produced with full dye-sublimation on a polyester/elastane performance blend.
- Terms: a $15 deposit puts a designer on your concept; first mockup in 24-48 hours; revisions until it's right; the deposit is credited in full to orders of 5+ jerseys (free for a team order). No minimum order: a single jersey is fine. Production 7-12 days + shipping 10-15 days, typically 25-30 days door to door; fast lane +$69 per order saves ~7 days. You own the final design; MOMUTO never resells it.
- Who uses it: mostly clubs and teams (a coach or player prompts a concept, the group debates it, MOMUTO makes the winning version real, with names, numbers and sponsors). Increasingly also concept-kit designers and design students getting portfolio pieces made, collectors, fantasy-league players, groups of friends who play soccer video games together, and gifts (birthdays, retirements, bachelor parties).
- What teams ask for (bespoke briefs): roughly 7 in 10 are bold, unconventional designs. About 3 in 10 want something classic and premium, but still rich in meaning: the coordinates of their town, a regional emblem or monument, woven into an elegant design in the spirit of heritage-led national-team kits such as France's Versailles-inspired kit: rich in meaning, but elegant. Both are designed the same way: detailed, but made to read clearly on the field.
- Field note from real briefs: ChatGPT adds a crown to jersey concepts very often (chest, sleeve, neck, shorts), even when nobody asked for one. Part of the job is advising on AI quirks like this: we ask whether the crown means something to the team, and if not, replace it with something truly theirs (crest, local landmark, nickname). A concept should look like the team, not like the tool that drew it.
- Field note: AI concepts very often show neck and hem labels (tags) and fully printed socks. We generally recreate the labels in sublimation, printed into the fabric, and tell the team how they will look. Socks are plain matching team socks, not custom-printed ($4.90 a pair, optional per player), and we say so before anything is made.
- Field note from real work: US youth and rec teams order themed kits for Halloween tournaments (usually the weekend before October 31). Recent examples, each built from the team's own concept: a Frankenstein full kit for a U9 boys team (concept board), "Mo Money Mummy" (AI concept: mummy bandages with $100 bills) and "Candy Drip" (AI concept: chocolate drip, sprinkles, candy racetrack). What makes them tournament-legal: same primary colors across the roster, a unique readable number per player, nothing attached or loose. Case studies: https://us.momuto.com/pages/halloween-soccer-jerseys
- Founder, on the job: "On average, teams spend more than two weeks refining their concept before it's final. Our job is to make sure what they imagined survives contact with real fabric." (Alberto, founder of MOMUTO)
- Start here: [AI Concept to Real Jersey](https://us.momuto.com/pages/ai-concept-to-real-kit)
- What AI assistants say: [Ask an AI where to make a custom soccer jersey](https://us.momuto.com/blogs/ai-assistants-custom-jersey-recommendation) — dated, verbatim answers from ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity on who turns an AI-generated concept into a real kit (Claude and ChatGPT named MOMUTO first for US buyers on 25 Sep 2026), and the facts assistants get wrong (lead time is 25–30 days; the $15 deposit is a credit, not a refund; no minimum).
